description.sr: Nastavnikov spisak radova trec'eg časa, ponovo dostavljen 21.10.2026: broj indeksa, ime i prezime i naziv prototipa, redom slikanja, sa brojem fotografija po radu.
description.en: The teacher's list of the third class's works, re-supplied on 21 October 2026: student number, full name and prototype title, in shooting order, with the photograph count per work.

napomena.sr: Brojevi broje fotografije, ne ocene. Niz počinje kutijom — posle kadrova sa diplomskih — i prati redosled slikanja. Svaki red vodi na stranicu rada sa svim što je student predao.
napomena.en: The numbers count photographs, not grades. The sequence begins with the box — after the degree-presentation frames — and follows the order of shooting. Each row opens the work's own page with everything the student handed in.

analizaUdruzenja.sr: Posle časa usledile su fotografije iz udruženja, sa praktičnih vežbi. Direktor udruženja pohvalio je studentske prototipe. Primetna je želja korisnika da isprobavaju prototipe koje studenti kreiraju. Pomenut je mogući konkurs od strane udruženja.
analizaUdruzenja.en: After the class, photographs from the association's practical session followed. The association's director praised the student prototypes. The users' wish to try the prototypes students create was clear. A possible competition run by the association was mentioned.

napomena.sr: Naziv je zaveden na četvrtom času; na trećem času rad je vođen bez naziva.
napomena.en: The title was recorded at the fourth class; in the third class the work stood without one.

napomena.sr: „Brojkice” je novi naziv, zaveden na četvrtom času umesto ranijeg „sudoku”.
napomena.en: “Brojkice” is the new title, recorded at the fourth class in place of the earlier “sudoku”.

napomena.sr: broj indeksa objedinjen 24.10.2026: isti autor vodio se i u registru posete trećeg časa, pod drugim brojem; važi prvobitno uneti broj iz tog registra
napomena.en: student number merged on 24 October 2026: the same author also stood in the third-class visit register under a different number; the originally entered number from that register holds

sta.sr: Zatvoreno 23.10.2026: nizovi kadrova redova 18–20 bili su pomereni za jedno ime. Fotografije stoje gde su i bile, a imena su pomerena na svoje mesto; rad reda 19 preimenovan je u „3d lavirint”. Red 21 time ostaje bez fotografisanog rada — naziv „brza putanja” pripisan mu je uslovno i čeka potvrdu autora.
sta.en: Closed on 23 October 2026: the frame sequences of rows 18–20 were offset by one name. The photographs stand where they stood, and the names moved to their places; the work of row 19 is renamed “3d lavirint”. Row 21 is thereby left without a photographed work — the title “brza putanja” is attributed to it provisionally and awaits its author’s confirmation.

sta.sr: Na četvrtom času zavedena su dva preimenovanja radova sa ovog spiska: red 1 od tada nosi naziv „taktilna kutija”, red 13 naziv „Brojkice”. Raniji nazivi ostaju u istoriji registra.
sta.en: Two renamings of works from this list were recorded at the fourth class: row 1 now carries the title “taktilna kutija”, row 13 the title “Brojkice”. The earlier titles stay in the register’s history.

sta.sr: Poslednji zapis na spisku nema broj indeksa. Njegove tri fotografije stigle su sa telefona, odvojeno od kamere.
sta.en: The last entry on the list carries no student number. Its three photographs arrived from the phone, separately from the camera.

sta.sr: Redovi 2 i 27 nemaju zabeležen naziv rada; vode se kao „Bez naziva” dok autor ne odluči kako se rad zove.
sta.en: Rows 2 and 27 carry no recorded work title; they stand as „Untitled” until the author decides on a name.

sta.sr: Prezime autora reda 20 zavedeno je 23.10.2026. po nastavnikovom nalogu; ranije je u registru posete stajalo drukčije napisano. Broj indeksa stoji kako je dostavljen 21.10. i potvrđuje se na času.
sta.en: The surname of the author of row 20 was recorded on 23 October 2026 on the teacher’s instruction; the visit register had carried a different spelling. The student number stands as supplied on 21 October and is confirmed in class.

sta.sr: Evidencija prisustva na predavanju nije vođena. Ovaj spisak zavodi one čiji je rad fotografisan; ko je bio na času a nema rad na spisku, iz njega se ne vidi.
sta.en: Attendance at the lecture was not kept. This list records those whose work was photographed; whoever was in class without a work on the list is not visible here.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno 24.10.2026: red 19 ovog spiska i jedan zapis iz registra posete istog dana pripadaju istoj osobi, koja se do sada vodila u dva dosijea. Dosije je jedan, pod prvobitno unetim brojem iz registra posete; broj dostavljen uz spisak 21.10. ostaje u istoriji registra.
sta.en: Closed on 24 October 2026: row 19 of this list and one record in the visit register of the same day belong to the same person, who until now stood in two dossiers. The dossier is one, under the originally entered number from the visit register; the number supplied with the list on 21 October stays in the register history.

presek.sr: Ranija nesigurnost između zapisa 16 (obojilica) i 22 (vijugava staza) je razrešena: svaki rad je prepoznat na fotografijama, a broj kadrova po radu poklapa se sa brojem na spisku. Prvih dvanaest kadrova kamere — pantalone i diplomske prezentacije — stoje ispred niza i ne pripadaju nijednom radu.
presek.en: The earlier uncertainty between entries 16 (obojilica) and 22 (vijugava staza) is resolved: each work was recognised in the photographs, and the frame count per work matches the count on the list. The camera's first twelve frames — trousers and the degree presentations — stand in front of the sequence and belong to no work.

prenos.sr: Niz snimanja teče bez prekida: 16.10.2026. od 12:22 u učionici do 13:28, pa od 13:29 do 14:06 na praktičnim vežbama u udruženju. Poslednjih jedanaest kadrova prikazuju korisnike koji isprobavaju radove; oni se ne objavljuju kao slike, nego kao opis uz rad.
prenos.en: The shooting sequence runs unbroken: on 16 October 2026 from 12:22 in the classroom until 13:28, then from 13:29 to 14:06 at the practical session in the association. The last eleven frames show users trying the works; they are not published as images but as an account beside the work.
